item.title: Wreck-It Ralph Ride Coming to Tokyo Disneyland, Mashle Season 3
item.description: A Wreck-It Ralph ride is coming to Tokyo Disneyland, Mashle Season 3 arrives in January 2027, and Laika's Wildwood opens with $12.2 million. We also cover a new Cardfight!! Vanguard anime, a villain-heroine Precure spinoff, Gundam Battle Operation 3 for PS5 and PC, and a weekly animated Play-Doh show for kids.
